ITEM 1 | Pale yellow mashed mass with a smooth-to-lumpy texture, covering roughly 45% of the plate in a central cluster about 12 cm across and 2 cm high, with some crumbly edge pieces; sits on a white square plate | 180
ITEM 2 | Bright orange finely shredded or grated strands, mixed through and on top of the pale yellow mass in streaks about 6 cm long, matte with slight moisture, forming a band across the center-left of the pile | 35
ITEM 3 | Scattered small pale yellow crumbly pieces, roughly 1 to 2 cm each, lying loose on the plate to the right and lower-left of the main mass, dry-looking with slightly rough surfaces | 25
